description: Dedicated server of the SA:COOP fork (GTA San Andreas co-op). One UDP port. Settings in server.ini, data in server-data.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# SA:COOP dedicated server: the release's Linux archive into /mnt/server.
# A reinstall replaces the program and keeps server.ini, balance_exclude.ini and server-data.
set -e
apt-get update -y
apt-get install -y curl ca-certificates tar
mkdir -p /mnt/server /tmp/sa-coop
cd /tmp/sa-coop
curl -fsSL -o server.tar.gz "https://github.com/${GITHUB_REPO}/releases/download/${VERSION}/coop-server-linux-x86_64.tar.gz"
tar -xzf server.tar.gz --strip-components=1
cp coop-server /mnt/server/coop-server
chmod +x /mnt/server/coop-server
for f in server.ini balance_exclude.ini; do
    [ -f "/mnt/server/$f" ] || cp "$f" "/mnt/server/$f"
done
cp README.md /mnt/server/README.md
echo "SA:COOP server ${VERSION} installed"
